purpose: Records what the creator manually changed after generation (a different ending picked, a hook rewritten, a title swapped) so a future feedback-learning step has real data to learn from. Does NOT currently feed back into generation automatically — see activation_criteria below.
activation_criteria: Do not wire this into MASTER_PROMPT.md's generation logic until at least 20-30 logged episodes exist with edits recorded. Below that volume, patterns drawn from this data would be noise, not signal, and risk pulling generation away from DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md's fixed rules based on a handful of anecdotal preferences. When volume is sufficient, any derived preference must still be checked against DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md and never override a non-negotiable rule — per important_safety_reminders on this pattern generally: a feedback loop must not erode fixed quality/safety standards over time.
